data.text:
Explore what's possible with Google AI.

Chat with Gemini, your personal AI assistant, and ask anything, any way, in Google Search. Create and edit videos with Gemini Omni, and create and edit images with Nano Banana, seamlessly crafting cinematic clips, scenes, and stories. Understand anything with your research and thinking partner.

### For creativity

Create and inspire with Gemini Omni and Nano Banana.

*   Scale your workflows with Google Flow Agent, all under your control.
*   Discover and create images with built-in templates you can instantly remix.
*   Create more relevant, personal images using Nano Banana and your own Google Photos library.
*   Use Nano Banana 2 to create images powered by advanced world knowledge.
*   Create custom soundtracks in the Gemini app with Lyria 3, our latest generative music model.
*   Try ready-made AI templates in Google Photos to help you create images based on popular edits.

### For knowledge

Discover helpful tools for learning.

*   Get interactive visuals in real-time, completely customized for your specific question.
*   Build custom coded tools, like a tracker for on-going tasks, without you having to write a single line of code. For example, track a wedding guest list or monitor a moving dashboard.
*   Get real-time help with Search Live in the Google app, receiving notifications about events like biotech stock volume spikes matching your criteria.
*   Go on a guided walking tour with Gemini in Google Maps, or get hands-free directions while biking.
*   Verify if an image was generated by Google AI directly in the Gemini app.
*   See how ideas relate with Mind Maps, such as a Gemini Notebook Mind Map for "Surrealist art movement" branching into sub-topics like "Development and Technique," "Timeline and Duration," and "Artists Mentioned."

### For productivity

Enhance your efficiency and streamline workflows.

*   Create information agents in Search to work 24/7, analyze data, and help you take action.
*   Let a 24/7 personal AI agent help you navigate your digital life, under your direction.
*   Create new Docs from scratch based on relevant information from your files and emails.
*   Organize your chats and projects in the Gemini app with our AI-powered research partner, Gemini Notebook, which can generate summaries and reference sources from research topics like the "Surrealist art movement."
*   Access your favorite Google tools without switching tabs with Gemini in Chrome.
*   Respond to emails in one-click with Suggested Replies that use the context of your conversation.

### For students

Learn in ways that work for you.

*   Prep for the SAT with practice tests in Gemini.
*   Use Guided Learning to go deeper into topics and learn, with Socratic questioning to help solve problems like rocket energy, as shown in a "Before and After" comparison in Gemini Pro 2.5.
*   Transform your source material into an engaging explainer video.
*   Dive deeper on your research questions with Deep Research.
*   Discover additional sources on topics to support your studies.
*   Get step by step homework help with Google Lens, which can highlight equations like $x^2 - 4 = 0$ on graph paper and display "How to solve" instructions.

### For experimenting

Discover and try AI experimental products.

*   Build or refine your business identity in moments, with the help of our agent, displaying brand assets like logos, fonts, colors, and photography for businesses such as Banza.
*   Share your generated worlds to let others watch a video preview, explore, or remix them.
*   Transform ideas into UI designs for mobile and web applications.
*   Explore and refine your ideas with an AI-powered concepting board.
*   Discover the future capabilities of a universal AI assistant with Project Astra, a research prototype by Google DeepMind.
*   Explore new possibilities for your career.

### Latest news

*   Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash.
*   Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber.
*   I/O 2026: Welcome to the agentic Gemini era.
*   Introducing Gemini Omni.
*   The Gemini app becomes more agentic, delivering proactive, 24/7 help.
